title: Niklaus Wirth's Oberon operating system running bare metal on a $15 Raspberry Pi
description:
Niklaus Wirth's Oberon operating system running bare metal on a $15 Raspberry Pi, no Linux underneath, no emulation layer. Flash the SD card, plug it in, and it boots directly into the Oberon graphical desktop in seconds on a Pi 3B, Pi Zero 2, or Olimex ESP32. A 1980s operating system designed for minimalism, running on modern hardware exactly as intended. The kind of project that exists purely because someone thought it should.

https://github.com/rochus-keller/OberonSystem3Native

#github #opensource
